# nextdns_profile (Resource)

A NextDNS profile. Its settings, such as security and privacy, are managed by their own resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nextdns_profile" "home" {
  name = "Home"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Profile name, as shown in the NextDNS dashboard.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Profile fingerprint, used in the DNS-over-HTTPS and DNS-over-TLS addresses.
- `id` (String) Profile ID, for example `abc123`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = nextdns_profile.home
  id = "abc123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nextdns_profile.home "abc123"
```
